rules.name: pair_balance_only_swap
rules.expr: ok and not called("SimplePair.swap") and post("balanceOf", A2) < pre("balanceOf", A2)
rules.why: pair's tokens only leave through a swap; sell tax must be taken from the seller, not the pair

rules.name: pair_receives_on_sell
rules.expr: ok and (called("transfer") or called("transferFrom")) and sender != A2 and post("balanceOf", A2) < pre("balanceOf", A2)
rules.why: selling to the pair never lowers the pair's balance

rules.name: reserves_backed0
rules.expr: ok and post("SimplePair.reserve0") > pre("SimplePair.reserve0") and not called("SimplePair.swap") and not called("SimplePair.sync") and not called("transfer") and not called("transferFrom")
rules.why: reserves only change via pair functions or sync

rules.name: receiver_gets_at_most_amount
rules.expr: ok and called("transfer") and arg(0) != sender and post("balanceOf", arg(0)) - pre("balanceOf", arg(0)) > arg(1)

rules.name: sender_pays_at_least
rules.expr: ok and called("transfer") and arg(0) != sender and pre("balanceOf", sender) - post("balanceOf", sender) < arg(1)

rules.name: exempt_auth
rules.expr: ok and post("isExempt", u) != pre("isExempt", u) and sender != pre("owner")
